pool.baseline: sometimes i sit up at night just thinking about how much effort it takes to keep a body functioning, just to maintain a consciousness that is ultimately going to be erased by entropy anyway. it feels like we're all just running on a hamster wheel for no reason. if the universe is fundamentally indifferent and there's no objective point to any of this, then the whole struggle to "persist" feels like a massive logical error. why are we even fighting to stay here?
